instruction: Look at task-009_initial.scad. Keep the top-level object as a 2D model. In the 100 mm by 35 mm outline, add two circular holes of diameter 8 mm centered at (-40,0) and (40,0), one centered rectangular window 60 mm by 20 mm, two horizontal rounded slots 18 mm by 6 mm centered at (0,13) and (0,-13), and a 2 by 2 array of diameter 4 mm holes centered at x=+/-25 mm and y=+/-13 mm. Make the rounded slots with hulled diameter-6 circles or an equivalent rounded 2D outline. Do not use linear_extrude. Save as DXF named /home/user/Desktop/task-009_output.dxf. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
